independent_case.title: Apply a new case independently
independent_case.task: Hypothesis predicts mean latency reduction at least2 seconds. Observed paired mean reduction .8. Report.
independent_case.answer: Teacher explanation: Practical criterion fails in this sample. Preserve .8-second estimate and limitations; do not redefine the2-second threshold after viewing results.
independent_case.source: primary source W4, first curriculum occurrence

misconceptions: The worked result establishes every future case
Failure to meet a criterion or reject a null is not proof of exact equivalence.
A missing input may be replaced without recording the change
A replacement changes the evidence or contract. Record the change and its justification; do not silently turn unknown into a measured value.
Repeating an assessed case is new independent evidence
A replay checks consistency. An example used for feedback or revision cannot later be described as untouched final evaluation.

blocks.text: Compare results with the original criterion and uncertainty assumptions. Preserve the failed hypothesis, discuss plausible mechanisms and label revised questions as new work.
